notes.title: Gamescom, Demo Update, and Backerkit!
notes.content: [h1]Button Man is coming to Gamescom for the second year![/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882084/3d3f24440c7f71e06cd14f3e65c2ac1a2d965a6b.png"][/img][/p][p]For the second year we are bringing Button Man to the Indie Area of Gamescom at Hall 10.2! Come join us for 4 intensive days and get a behind the scenes and personal look at the game, the comic, and the goodies :)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882084/9cbee3a156d5840e2f499db9584605d26de9772c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Demo Update Soon![/h1][h3]Act 1 Preview![/h3][p]Act 1 of the game is being added in, with the first two quests and the open town ready by Gamescom time for your enjoyment![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882084/764bd22c720c3473b24f63bbb55abd9bf80618ac.png"][/img][/p][h3]More Locations![/h3][p]We have added the main streets of the city to explore, each inspired by real life locations in Halifax Nova Scotia. While many of our indoor locations are still WIP we would like to give you a chance to explore and feel the atmosphere of our version of Halifax for yourself. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882084/2a447bf490d36f5fd3e3d2caa79e9542c18e9fc7.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882084/0015caac9c5ac8e9e0069726161466b0fb251a23.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882084/beb9d72de40e0ea3d3f5f2fbe293377fb07f0c2d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882084/ce21a3223eb5711649d2ddf909ff4094128bcc48.png"][/img][/p][h3]Better Combat![/h3][p]We have improved the fighting in the game both mechanically and visually. Alongside those improvements we have added grabbing to the combat, allowing you to hold some opponents and fling them away.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882084/3bf563f096ad46854a174cf4bbfc7464576008e4.png"][/img][/p][h3]More Choices![/h3][p]Choices will be the pillar of the game's story, and we are adding some important ones to the game. Those will have an effect later in the game but you'll have the chance to see where we're going and hypothesize. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882084/2a7c2a35fb813dfb9d7b76e6bda33313013135a2.png"][/img][/p][h3]Trolly System![/h3][p]Trolly is coming to town, allowing you to fast travel to select areas around the map![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882084/b53577876159c83d7ceb157e9a5a36e4bb28902b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Backerkit Crowdfunding[/h1][p][/p][p]We are pleased to announce that we will be in Backerkit soon to crowdfund Button Man to completion! We hope that you will sign up to get an alert when the pledging begins and join us on our journey to complete the game and give you the adventure game you deserve! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882084/8566e6c2e16a776cb46dc7696a007c91e4866951.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://www.backerkit.com/call_to_action/c2993f0d-01e0-4862-abcc-57d464596d63/landing" style="button"]Support Us on Backerkit![/url][/p][p][/p][h2]More to come after Gamescom 2025![/h2][p][/p][p]Join us on [url="https://discord.gg/YfjGenFWzB" style="button"]Discord![/url][/p]

tags.feature: Act 1 of the game is being added in, with the first two quests and the open town ready by Gamescom time for your enjoyment!

We have added the main streets of the city to explore, each inspired by real life locations in Halifax Nova Scotia. While many of our indoor locations are still WIP we would like to give you a chance to explore and feel the atmosphere of our version of Halifax for yourself.
We have improved the fighting in the game both mechanically and visually. Alongside those improvements we have added grabbing to the combat, allowing you to hold some opponents and fling them away.

Choices will be the pillar of the game's story, and we are adding some important ones to the game. Those will have an effect later in the game but you'll have the chance to see where we're going and hypothesize.
Trolly is coming to town, allowing you to fast travel to select areas around the map!
